inference: FIELD_MAP labels the five values on the exact Class_9966532d owner. Matching class identity and descriptor hash let the L148 Frag profile serve as a source comparison.

Both root links resolve directly to in-file Class_9966532d objects. Both checked curve-pointer fields are null on these two objects, while L148 shows Frag selecting a seven-point curve via Field_0839b22b.
These are serialized source values only. The field names and values do not establish units, runtime activation, or effective damage composition.
unresolved: Physical units and formulas for the Class_9966532d damage/radius fields remain unknown.
Serialized fields do not establish runtime activation, effective damage composition, curve precedence, or native trigger/damage behavior.
Field_0839b22b is null on these two selected blast objects; this does not establish absence of falloff through other fields or other mine variants.
siteImpact: Propose an optional source-profile comparison for AT Mine, M4 SLAM and Frag. Both mine projectile roots directly select mapped blast objects; their serialized BlastDamage fields store 300 and 100, compared with Frag 100. Display only source values after operator review; do not present effective gameplay damage or physical coverage until units and damage composition are validated.
